mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, content FROM comment WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (board_id, parent_comment_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{board_id}, #{parent_comment_id}, #{content}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET content = #{comment.content}, updated_at = now() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
